description: This file defines protocols related to streaming audio playback, specifically 'StreamingAudioPlaying' and 'PCMStreamingAudioPlaying', along with extensions linking these protocols to specific classes.

methods.name: play(stream: AsyncThrowingStream<Data, Error>)
methods.description: Plays an audio stream asynchronously, returning the playback result.

methods.name: stop()
methods.description: Stops audio playback and returns an optional Double, possibly indicating playback position.

methods.name: play(stream: AsyncThrowingStream<Data, Error>, sampleRate: Double)
methods.description: Plays an audio stream with specified sample rate asynchronously, returning the playback result.
